name: 39042 · Brandon, MS
findings: ZIP 39042 (Brandon) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39042 (Brandon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39042 (Brandon) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
